definitions.clean_outcome: A comeback with no penalty-goal event by either team from the cutoff onward.
definitions.clean_strict: A comeback with no penalty-shot event by either team from the cutoff onward.
definitions.eligible: A team is two or more goals down strictly before the cutoff.
definitions.full_match_sequence: A separate scan of all regulation-time events in all 2,379 selected matches; it is not conditioned on a two-goal deficit.
definitions.penalty_assisted_by_own_goal: A comeback where the focal team scored at least one penalty after the cutoff.
definitions.penalty_assisted_by_own_shot: A comeback where the focal team attempted at least one penalty after the cutoff.
definitions.team_states_equalizing_by_open_play: All eligible states that reached level after the cutoff without the equalizing goal being a penalty.
definitions.team_states_equalizing_by_own_penalty: All eligible states where a trailing team's penalty goal changed the live state from one goal down to level; final comeback is not required.
definitions.team_states_with_own_penalty_goal_while_: All eligible states where the trailing team scored a penalty while the live deficit was exactly two goals; final comeback is not required.
definitions.team_states_with_two_own_penalty_goals_w: All eligible states where the trailing team scored two penalty goals within a rolling 10-minute interval after the cutoff.
definitions.team_states_with_two_own_penalty_shots_w: All eligible states where the trailing team had two or more penalty-shot events within a rolling 10-minute interval after the cutoff.
definitions.three_plus: A comeback where the focal team attempted at least three penalties after the cutoff.

limitations: StatsBomb event coverage is an explicit availability sample, not all football history.
Penalty-shot events are an event-feed proxy and do not adjudicate whether an award was correct.
The focal match is kept as a labeled case because it is not part of the historical benchmark source.
At 79:00 Argentina was already 1-2 after Romero's 78th-minute goal; the 79-minute benchmark is not a claim that the focal state was still 0-2.
